intent: Add an admin dashboard with user growth metrics and a role-based access gate.
notes: Product surface plus a technical/security constraint; gold at sentence granularity.

known_facts.statement: An admin dashboard must expose user growth metrics to operators.
Only authorized roles should be able to view the dashboard.

assumptions.statement: The growth metrics can be computed from existing user records.

options.statement: Embed the metrics into the existing admin surface instead of a separate app.

decisions.statement: Enforce the role check on the server, not only by hiding controls in the UI.

open_questions.statement: Clarify which roles may see which metric.
